_readme: Template for KMTrack's interchange/ramp name layer. This file is SEPARATE from calibration.json and never affects km-station math — it only powers the 'near ramp: X' label. Replace the sample ramp below with real data, then host this file alongside index.html/calibration.json (same folder), named exactly 'ramps.json'.

_schema.matchRadiusMeters: Optional. How close (in meters) you must be to a ramp's point trail to trigger its label. Default is 50 if omitted.
_schema.ramps: Array of ramp objects. Each needs: name, interchange (optional), and points (an ordered list of {lat, lon} breadcrumbs collected by driving the ramp).
